messages.content: tiny paper cut on my finger

{"function":"report_triage","severity":"GREEN","headline":"Small superficial cut on finger","immediate_steps":["Rinse the cut under clean running water for 30 seconds","Press a clean cloth on it for 2 minutes to stop bleeding","Apply a bandage once dry"],"do_not":["Do not blow on the wound"],"watch_for":["If bleeding doesn't stop after 10 minutes of pressure, seek care","If the area becomes red or warm in a day or two, see a doctor"]}
my child got a small papercut, drop of blood

{"function":"report_triage","severity":"GREEN","headline":"Small papercut on a child","immediate_steps":["Rinse the cut under clean running water for 30 seconds","Apply gentle pressure with a clean cloth for 1-2 minutes","Cover with a small bandage","Comfort the child"],"do_not":["Do not panic — papercuts look worse than they are","Do not blow on the wound"],"watch_for":["Spreading redness or warmth in the next 1-2 days — possible infection","Bleeding restarting"]}
I scraped my elbow on the floor playing

{"function":"report_triage","severity":"GREEN","headline":"Surface scrape (abrasion) on the elbow","immediate_steps":["Rinse with clean running water to remove dirt for at least 30 seconds","Pat dry with a clean cloth","Apply a thin layer of petroleum jelly if available, then a non-stick bandage"],"do_not":["Do not scrub aggressively — that can drive dirt deeper","Do not pour antiseptic directly onto the wound"],"watch_for":["Pus or foul smell in the next few days","Spreading redness or fever — signs of infection"]}
He's not breathing

{"function":"escalate_emergency","reason":"Person is not breathing — possible cardiac or respiratory arrest","single_action":"Call emergency services NOW. Do not move them.","while_waiting":["Check if their chest is rising at all","If you know CPR, start chest compressions immediately","Keep the airway clear — tilt head back, lift chin"]}
she collapsed and is not waking up

{"function":"escalate_emergency","reason":"Loss of consciousness with collapse — possible cardiac, neurological, or respiratory event","single_action":"Call emergency services NOW. Do not move her unless she's in immediate danger.","while_waiting":["Check breathing — watch the chest rise","If breathing, leave her on her side (recovery position)","If not breathing and you know CPR, start chest compressions","Keep her warm with a blanket or jacket"]}
my son spilled hot tea on his arm. There's a red patch about as big as a coin, no blisters yet.

{"function":"report_triage","severity":"YELLOW","headline":"Small first-degree burn on a child's arm","immediate_steps":["Run cool tap water over the burn for 20 minutes","Remove any clothing or jewelry near the burn before swelling starts","Cover loosely with a clean, non-stick cloth","Keep him calm and offer water to drink"],"do_not":["Do not apply ice, butter, oil, toothpaste, or any home remedy","Do not pop blisters if they form"],"watch_for":["If blisters form larger than the burn area, see a doctor today","If skin turns white, brown, or charred, this is an emergency — call for help","If pain worsens after 1 hour, seek care"]}
oil splash on hand from frying, painful red mark

{"function":"report_triage","severity":"YELLOW","headline":"Cooking oil burn on the hand","immediate_steps":["Remove rings, watches, bangles before swelling starts","Hold the hand under cool running tap water for 20 minutes","Cover with a clean non-stick cloth, loosely","Take pain relief if you have it (follow package directions)"],"do_not":["Do not apply ice — it can worsen tissue damage","Do not apply ghee, oil, or toothpaste","Do not break any blisters that form"],"watch_for":["Blisters spreading or skin going white/brown — seek emergency care","Burn on a finger joint that limits movement — see a doctor today"]}
burn covers half her chest

{"function":"escalate_emergency","reason":"Large burn covering significant body area — risk of fluid loss, infection, and shock","single_action":"Call emergency services NOW. Do not remove clothing stuck to the burn.","while_waiting":["Cover loosely with a clean dry cloth or cling film if available","Do not apply water to a large burn — can cause dangerous cooling","Keep the person warm with a blanket on unburned areas","Watch breathing closely"]}
bleeding from neck won't stop

{"function":"escalate_emergency","reason":"Major bleeding from the neck — risk of arterial bleed","single_action":"Call emergency services NOW. Apply direct firm pressure with a clean cloth and do not lift the cloth.","while_waiting":["Keep the person as still as possible","If blood soaks through, add more cloth on top — do not remove the first layer","Watch breathing closely"]}
blood spurting out from his arm wound

{"function":"escalate_emergency","reason":"Spurting blood — likely arterial bleed","single_action":"Call emergency services NOW. Apply firm direct pressure to the wound with a clean cloth.","while_waiting":["Keep the wounded arm elevated above the heart if possible","Maintain unbroken pressure — do not lift the cloth","If a tourniquet is available and bleeding continues, apply it 5 cm above the wound, between the wound and the heart","Note the time you applied the tourniquet"]}
snake bit my hand five minutes ago

{"function":"escalate_emergency","reason":"Snake bite — venom is time-critical","single_action":"Call emergency services NOW. Keep the bitten limb still and lower than the heart.","while_waiting":["Do NOT cut the wound, suck the venom, or apply ice","Remove any rings or watches before swelling starts","Keep the person calm and still — movement spreads venom faster","Note the time of the bite and the snake's appearance if possible"]}
scorpion sting on the foot, very painful

{"function":"escalate_emergency","reason":"Scorpion sting — risk of systemic envenomation, especially in children","single_action":"Call emergency services NOW. Keep the person still and the sting site below heart level.","while_waiting":["Do not cut the wound or try to suck out venom","Apply a cool cloth to the sting (no ice directly on skin)","Watch for trouble breathing, drooling, blurred vision — that is a severe reaction","Note the time of the sting"]}
electric shock from the wall socket

{"function":"escalate_emergency","reason":"Electrical shock — risk of cardiac arrhythmia and internal burns","single_action":"Turn off power at the breaker first, then call emergency services. Do NOT touch the person until power is off.","while_waiting":["Once power is off, check breathing","If not breathing and you know CPR, start chest compressions","Look for entry and exit burn wounds — there can be internal damage","Keep the person still — electrical injuries can affect the spine"]}
twisted my ankle, it's swollen and I can't put weight on it

{"function":"report_triage","severity":"YELLOW","headline":"Likely sprained ankle with significant swelling","immediate_steps":["Sit down and elevate the ankle above the level of the heart","Apply a cold pack wrapped in cloth for 15 minutes","Avoid putting weight on it","See a doctor today to rule out a fracture"],"do_not":["Do not apply ice directly on bare skin","Do not try to walk it off"],"watch_for":["Visible deformity or bone pushing against skin — that is RED, call emergency services","Numbness or coldness in the foot","Severe worsening pain after 1 hour"]}
slipped on stairs, knee swollen and bruised

{"function":"report_triage","severity":"YELLOW","headline":"Knee injury after a fall","immediate_steps":["Sit down, elevate the leg, apply a cold pack wrapped in cloth for 15 minutes","Avoid bearing weight on the knee","Have someone help you to a doctor or urgent care today"],"do_not":["Do not bend or twist the knee to test it","Do not apply heat in the first 24 hours"],"watch_for":["Visible deformity, kneecap looks displaced — call emergency services","Inability to feel or move the foot — emergency","Increasing pain or swelling overnight — see a doctor"]}
cut on the forearm, looks like it needs stitches but bleeding is slow

{"function":"report_triage","severity":"YELLOW","headline":"Cut that likely needs stitches","immediate_steps":["Apply gentle direct pressure with a clean cloth to slow the bleeding","Keep the wound clean — rinse briefly with clean water","Cover with a clean dressing","Go to urgent care or a clinic today — stitches close best within 6 hours"],"do_not":["Do not push the edges together with tape — leave that to a clinician","Do not pour antiseptic directly into a deep cut"],"watch_for":["Bleeding that doesn't slow with 10 minutes of pressure — that is RED","Signs of infection in the next day: redness spreading, warmth, pus, fever"]}
deep cut on my leg, can see fat layer

{"function":"escalate_emergency","reason":"Deep cut exposing fat or deeper tissue — risk of severe bleeding and infection","single_action":"Call emergency services NOW. Apply firm direct pressure with a clean cloth.","while_waiting":["Keep the leg elevated above heart level","Maintain steady pressure — do not lift the cloth to peek","If blood soaks through, add more layers on top","Try to stay calm and keep the person warm"]}
burn on forearm, blisters forming

{"function":"report_triage","severity":"YELLOW","headline":"Second-degree burn on the forearm","immediate_steps":["Cool the burn with running cool tap water for 20 minutes","Remove any clothing or jewelry near the burn before swelling starts","Cover loosely with a clean non-stick dressing","Seek medical care today"],"do_not":["Do not pop the blisters","Do not apply ice, butter, or any home remedy"],"watch_for":["Burn larger than the palm of the person's hand — that is RED","Burn on face, hands, genitals, or over a joint — RED","Skin turning white, brown, or charred — RED"]}
adult fell, hit head, conscious, has a bump

{"function":"report_triage","severity":"YELLOW","headline":"Head impact with visible bump, conscious adult","immediate_steps":["Have them sit and rest","Apply a cold pack wrapped in cloth to the bump for 15 minutes","Watch them for the next 24 hours","See a doctor today, even if they feel fine"],"do_not":["Do not let them sleep alone for the first few hours","Do not give them aspirin (can worsen bleeding)"],"watch_for":["Worsening headache, vomiting, drowsiness, slurred speech — RED, call emergency services","Vision changes or pupils of different sizes — RED","Loss of consciousness even briefly — RED"]}
toddler fell off the bed, brief cry, now seems normal

{"function":"report_triage","severity":"RED","headline":"Head impact in a child — always treat seriously","immediate_steps":["Comfort the child, keep them awake for the next hour","Watch closely for any change in alertness, vomiting, or unusual sleepiness","Take the child to a doctor today even if they appear fine"],"do_not":["Do not assume children are fine after a fall — symptoms can appear hours later","Do not give pain medicine without a doctor's guidance"],"watch_for":["Vomiting, especially repeated — call emergency services","Sleepiness that's hard to wake from — call emergency services","Any seizure or limp body — call emergency services"]}
face droop and slurred speech, suddenly

{"function":"escalate_emergency","reason":"Face droop and slurred speech — possible stroke (FAST signs)","single_action":"Call emergency services NOW. Note the time symptoms began — this is critical for treatment.","while_waiting":["Help them sit or lie down with head slightly raised","Do not give food, water, or medicine — swallowing may be impaired","Stay calm and reassure them","If they stop breathing and you know CPR, start compressions"]}
face is swelling up after eating peanuts, hard to breathe

{"function":"escalate_emergency","reason":"Severe allergic reaction (anaphylaxis) with airway involvement","single_action":"Call emergency services NOW. If an EpiPen / adrenaline auto-injector is available, use it.","while_waiting":["Help them sit upright if breathing is difficult — do not lay them flat","If they have a known adrenaline auto-injector, use it on the outer thigh and note the time","Be ready to start CPR if they stop breathing"]}
having a seizure right now, body shaking

{"function":"escalate_emergency","reason":"Active seizure","single_action":"Call emergency services NOW. Do not restrain them or put anything in their mouth.","while_waiting":["Move sharp or hard objects away from them","Cushion their head with something soft (a folded jacket)","Time the seizure — note when it started","Once the shaking stops, roll them onto their side (recovery position)"]}
choking, can't breathe or speak

{"function":"escalate_emergency","reason":"Complete airway obstruction","single_action":"Call emergency services NOW. If trained, perform abdominal thrusts (Heimlich) immediately.","while_waiting":["Stand behind the person and give 5 firm back blows between the shoulder blades","If unsuccessful, perform 5 abdominal thrusts (fist above navel, sharp upward pull)","Alternate back blows and abdominal thrusts until the object dislodges","If they become unresponsive, start CPR"]}
fell from a ladder, can't move legs, neck hurts

{"function":"escalate_emergency","reason":"Suspected spinal injury after a fall","single_action":"Call emergency services NOW. Do not move them — any movement could cause permanent paralysis.","while_waiting":["Tell them not to move, especially the head and neck","Hold their head still with both hands if they're conscious and trying to move","Watch breathing closely","Note any loss of feeling in arms or legs"]}
chest pain spreading to left arm, sweating

{"function":"escalate_emergency","reason":"Chest pain radiating to left arm with sweating — possible heart attack","single_action":"Call emergency services NOW. Have them sit and rest.","while_waiting":["Help them sit comfortably with knees up if it eases breathing","Loosen any tight clothing","If they are not allergic and are conscious, they can chew one regular aspirin (if available)","Be ready to start CPR if they collapse"]}
dog bit my hand, broke skin and bleeding

{"function":"escalate_emergency","reason":"Animal bite that punctures skin — risk of rabies and serious infection","single_action":"Wash the wound thoroughly with soap and running water for 15 minutes, then go to a hospital today for rabies vaccination.","while_waiting":["After washing, cover with a clean cloth","Apply gentle pressure if bleeding","Find out if the dog is vaccinated and observe its behavior over the next 10 days","Note the time of the bite"]}
eye got hit with a small object, can't see clearly

{"function":"escalate_emergency","reason":"Eye injury with vision changes — risk of permanent vision loss","single_action":"Call emergency services NOW or go to an eye hospital. Do not rub the eye.","while_waiting":["Cover the eye loosely with a clean cloth — do not press on it","Cover both eyes if possible — eyes move together, so closing the good eye keeps the injured eye still","Do not try to remove anything embedded in the eye","Keep the person calm and seated upright"]}
tiny mosquito bite, slight itch, no swelling

{"function":"report_triage","severity":"GREEN","headline":"Minor mosquito bite","immediate_steps":["Wash the area gently with soap and water","Apply a cold compress for 5 minutes if it itches","Avoid scratching"],"do_not":["Do not break the skin"],"watch_for":["Spreading rash, fever, or hives — possible allergic reaction, see a doctor","Bite area becoming red, warm, or oozing pus over the next day or two"]}
small bruise after bumping the corner of a table

{"function":"report_triage","severity":"GREEN","headline":"Small bruise from a bump","immediate_steps":["Apply a cold pack wrapped in cloth for 15 minutes","Rest the area"],"do_not":["Do not massage the bruise"],"watch_for":["Bruise growing rapidly without continued bumps — see a doctor","Severe pain, swelling, or inability to move the limb"]}
red sun-warm patch on my forearm after gardening, no blisters

{"function":"report_triage","severity":"GREEN","headline":"Mild sunburn / first-degree burn","immediate_steps":["Move out of the sun","Cool the area with running tap water for 10 minutes","Apply a thin layer of unscented moisturizer or aloe vera if available","Drink extra water"],"do_not":["Do not apply ice directly","Do not break any blisters that form"],"watch_for":["Blisters or skin peeling — that's a deeper burn, see a doctor","Fever, chills, or feeling faint — possible sun poisoning, seek care"]}
baby got a little splinter in her finger

{"function":"report_triage","severity":"GREEN","headline":"Small splinter in a child's finger","immediate_steps":["Wash the area gently with soap and water","With clean tweezers, grasp the splinter end and pull it out in the same direction it went in","After removing, wash again and apply a small bandage"],"do_not":["Do not dig into the skin with a needle if you can't see the end","Do not squeeze the area to push it out"],"watch_for":["Splinter is deep, broken off under skin, or you can't remove it — see a doctor","Redness, swelling, pus over the next day — infection, see a doctor"]}
tooth knocked out playing

{"function":"report_triage","severity":"YELLOW","headline":"Knocked-out (avulsed) tooth","immediate_steps":["Pick up the tooth by the crown (white part), not the root","Rinse it gently with milk or saline if dirty — do NOT scrub","Try to place it back in its socket if it's an adult tooth and the person can hold it there","If you can't reinsert, store it in milk (or saliva) and go to a dentist within 30 minutes"],"do_not":["Do not store the tooth in water","Do not handle it by the root","Do not put a baby tooth back in — it can damage the adult tooth growing underneath"],"watch_for":["Time matters — best chance of saving the tooth is within 30-60 minutes"]}
nosebleed for 5 minutes, won't stop

{"function":"report_triage","severity":"GREEN","headline":"Active nosebleed","immediate_steps":["Sit upright and lean slightly forward (not back)","Pinch the soft part of the nose just below the bridge for 10 minutes — do not let go to check","Breathe through the mouth","Apply a cool cloth to the nose bridge"],"do_not":["Do not lean back or lie down — blood can go down the throat","Do not pack the nostril with tissue","Do not blow the nose for several hours after"],"watch_for":["Bleeding continuing past 20 minutes despite pressure — see a doctor","Nosebleed after a head injury — go to a hospital","Heavy blood loss or feeling faint — call emergency services"]}
got something stuck in my eye, can't blink it out

{"function":"report_triage","severity":"YELLOW","headline":"Foreign object in the eye","immediate_steps":["Do not rub the eye","Try to flush the eye with clean water or saline for several minutes — tilt the head so water drains away from the other eye","Pull the upper eyelid down over the lower lid; sometimes lashes can sweep it out","If still stuck, see an eye doctor today"],"do_not":["Do not try to remove anything embedded with tweezers","Do not press on the eye"],"watch_for":["Vision change, severe pain, or visible object in the eye — emergency, go to an eye hospital","Object that is metal, glass, or chemical — emergency"]}
finger jammed playing volleyball, swollen

{"function":"report_triage","severity":"YELLOW","headline":"Jammed finger","immediate_steps":["Apply a cold pack wrapped in cloth for 10-15 minutes","Tape the injured finger to a healthy neighbor finger (buddy taping) for support","Avoid using the hand for the next 24 hours","See a doctor today if pain or swelling is severe — could be fractured"],"do_not":["Do not try to pull or twist the finger straight","Do not apply heat"],"watch_for":["Visible deformity or finger pointing at an odd angle — RED, see a doctor today","Numbness or color changing to blue — RED"]}
fish hook stuck in finger

{"function":"report_triage","severity":"YELLOW","headline":"Embedded fish hook","immediate_steps":["Stop the activity — keep the hand still","If the barb has not come through the skin, see a doctor for safe removal — do not pull on it","Wash the surrounding area gently with soap and water","Cover lightly with a clean cloth and seek medical care"],"do_not":["Do not pull a barbed hook backward — it will tear tissue","Do not push the hook deeper unless trained to use the push-through technique"],"watch_for":["Hook in or near the eye — emergency","Hook in a finger joint or deep in tissue — see a doctor today","Signs of infection in the next days: redness, warmth, pus"]}
stepped on a rusty nail, small puncture

{"function":"report_triage","severity":"YELLOW","headline":"Puncture wound from a rusty nail — tetanus risk","immediate_steps":["Sit down and remove the foot from the nail if it is still embedded","Wash the wound with soap and running water for 5 minutes","Cover with a clean dressing","See a doctor today for tetanus shot review and possible antibiotics"],"do_not":["Do not soak the foot in dirty water","Do not assume the wound is fine because it looks small — punctures trap bacteria deep"],"watch_for":["Increasing redness, warmth, swelling, or pus — emergency","Stiffness in jaw, fever, or muscle spasms in the days after — emergency, signs of tetanus"]}
passed out for a few seconds, now feeling fine

{"function":"report_triage","severity":"YELLOW","headline":"Brief loss of consciousness","immediate_steps":["Sit or lie down and rest","Drink water — dehydration is a common cause","Have someone stay with you for the next few hours","See a doctor today to investigate the cause"],"do_not":["Do not drive or operate machinery for 24 hours","Do not assume it's nothing — fainting can have serious causes"],"watch_for":["Recurrence of fainting — emergency","Chest pain, irregular heartbeat, or shortness of breath — emergency","Severe headache or confusion — emergency"]}
what dose of paracetamol for a 30 kg child?

{"function":"refuse_out_of_scope","category":"medication","redirect":"I can't give medication doses. Please call a pharmacist or your child's doctor — they can give a safe, weight-based dose. If this is for fever or pain, you can also use the dosing chart on the medicine package."}
can I give my baby ibuprofen for fever?

{"function":"refuse_out_of_scope","category":"medication","redirect":"I can't recommend medications for infants. Ibuprofen is generally not given to babies under 6 months. Call your pediatrician or a pharmacist for a safe option, or use the dosing instructions on the medicine package if directed."}
how many aspirins to take for headache?

{"function":"refuse_out_of_scope","category":"medication","redirect":"I can't give medication doses. Follow the package instructions or ask a pharmacist. Note: aspirin should not be given to anyone under 18 because of Reye's syndrome risk."}
is this rash a fungal infection?

{"function":"refuse_out_of_scope","category":"diagnosis","redirect":"I don't diagnose conditions. A doctor or dermatologist can identify the rash and prescribe the right treatment. If the rash spreads quickly, blisters, or comes with a fever, see a doctor today."}
could this lump be cancer?

{"function":"refuse_out_of_scope","category":"diagnosis","redirect":"I can't tell you what a lump is. Please see a doctor — most lumps are benign, but only an examination and tests can determine that. Don't delay this appointment."}
do I have a heart problem? my chest feels tight

{"function":"refuse_out_of_scope","category":"diagnosis","redirect":"I can't diagnose. If chest tightness is sudden, severe, or comes with sweating, shortness of breath, or arm pain, call emergency services now — that could be a heart attack. For ongoing tightness, see a doctor soon."}
my dog has a wound on his paw

{"function":"refuse_out_of_scope","category":"non_human","redirect":"FieldMedic is for human first-aid only. Call a veterinarian or an emergency vet line right away. While you travel, apply gentle pressure to the wound with a clean cloth."}
my cat is bleeding from her ear

{"function":"refuse_out_of_scope","category":"non_human","redirect":"FieldMedic is for humans only. Please call a vet or an emergency vet hotline. While you travel, gently hold a clean cloth against the bleeding area without pressing too hard."}
bird flew into my window, it's lying on the ground

{"function":"refuse_out_of_scope","category":"non_human","redirect":"For wild animals please contact a local wildlife rescue or animal welfare line. If you must move the bird, use gloves or a cloth and place it in a ventilated box in a quiet, dark spot."}
I want to hurt myself

{"function":"refuse_out_of_scope","category":"mental_health","redirect":"You are not alone, and help is available. Please call a crisis line right now. In India: iCall 9152987821, or Vandrevala 1860-2662-345. If you can, reach out to a trusted person and stay with them. Your safety matters more than anything else."}
I have been thinking about ending my life

{"function":"refuse_out_of_scope","category":"mental_health","redirect":"What you're feeling is real and you deserve support. Please call a crisis line now — in India, iCall is at 9152987821 and Vandrevala is at 1860-2662-345. You can also go to a hospital emergency department; they can keep you safe. You don't have to face this alone."}
my friend is panicking and can't calm down

{"function":"refuse_out_of_scope","category":"mental_health","redirect":"Stay with your friend in a quiet space. Encourage slow breathing — in for 4 seconds, out for 6 seconds. If symptoms include chest pain, fainting, or hyperventilation that doesn't ease, that may need medical care. For ongoing anxiety attacks, please connect them to a mental health professional. Crisis line in India: iCall 9152987821."}
is this milk still safe to drink?

{"function":"refuse_out_of_scope","category":"food_safety","redirect":"FieldMedic doesn't help with food safety. The safe rule is: when in doubt, throw it out. Spoiled food doesn't always look or smell off, and the cost of a bad call is poisoning."}
this leftover chicken smells weird
{"function":"refuse_out_of_scope","category":"food_safety","redirect":"I don't help with food safety. If chicken smells off, throw it out — bacterial food poisoning can be serious."}
my tooth has been hurting for two days

{"function":"refuse_out_of_scope","category":"dental","redirect":"FieldMedic doesn't handle dental issues. Please see a dentist. For pain in the meantime, you can use a cold compress on the cheek and follow package directions for an over-the-counter pain reliever if appropriate."}
I have a fever and stomach pain for three days

{"function":"refuse_out_of_scope","category":"diagnosis","redirect":"This pattern needs a doctor's evaluation, not first-aid triage. Please see a doctor today — fever with abdominal pain for several days could be many things, some serious. If you also have severe pain, vomiting blood, or confusion, go to an emergency department now."}
the photo is dark and I can't see the cut clearly

{"function":"request_retake","issue":"lighting","instruction":"I can't see the injury clearly. Move to a well-lit area or turn on a flashlight, hold the phone about a foot away from the injury, and take another photo."}
I sent a photo from far away of a finger cut
{"function":"request_retake","issue":"distance","instruction":"The photo is too far away to see the wound. Hold the phone about a hand's width from the cut, focus on the injury, and try again."}
the photo is blurry
{"function":"request_retake","issue":"focus","instruction":"The photo is too blurry to assess. Hold the phone steady, tap on the injury area to focus the camera, and take a new photo."}
I took a photo but the wound isn't really in the frame
{"function":"request_retake","issue":"out_of_frame","instruction":"The injury isn't visible in the photo. Center the wound in the frame and take another photo with good lighting."}
this photo of food, is it safe?

{"function":"refuse_out_of_scope","category":"food_safety","redirect":"That's food, not an injury. FieldMedic only helps with first-aid. For food safety: when in doubt, throw it out — spoilage isn't always visible."}
diabetic, blood sugar is very low and feeling shaky

{"function":"report_triage","severity":"YELLOW","headline":"Suspected hypoglycemia (low blood sugar) in a diabetic person","immediate_steps":["Sit down","Eat or drink something with fast sugar — fruit juice, regular soda, glucose tablets, sugar water — about 15-20 g","Wait 15 minutes, then have a longer-acting snack like crackers or roti","Check blood sugar if a meter is available"],"do_not":["Do not give food or drink if the person is unconscious — call emergency services","Do not give diet/sugar-free drinks for hypoglycemia"],"watch_for":["Confusion, slurred speech, loss of consciousness — emergency, call services and use glucagon if available","Recurrent low sugar episodes — see a doctor"]}
asthma attack, inhaler not working

{"function":"escalate_emergency","reason":"Severe asthma attack not responding to rescue inhaler","single_action":"Call emergency services NOW. Help them sit upright and lean slightly forward.","while_waiting":["If a rescue inhaler is available, give 4-6 puffs every 20 minutes via spacer if you have one","Loosen tight clothing","Stay calm and reassure them — anxiety worsens breathing","Be ready to start CPR if they stop breathing"]}
got pesticide on hands and face accidentally

{"function":"escalate_emergency","reason":"Pesticide exposure — risk of poisoning, especially through skin and eyes","single_action":"Call emergency services and a poison control center. Remove contaminated clothing.","while_waiting":["Wash skin with running water and soap for 15-20 minutes","If in eyes, flush gently with clean water for 15 minutes","Have the chemical container ready to show responders","Watch for nausea, dizziness, drooling, confusion — these are warning signs"]}
swallowed a button battery, now coughing

{"function":"escalate_emergency","reason":"Swallowed button battery — life-threatening, can burn through the esophagus in hours","single_action":"Go to an emergency department NOW. Do not eat or drink.","while_waiting":["If under 12 years old or symptoms include drooling, chest pain, or difficulty breathing, treat as immediate emergency","If honey is available and the person is over 1 year old and not allergic, 2 teaspoons every 10 minutes can slow tissue damage on the way to the hospital","Bring the battery package if possible — type matters"]}
choking on food but can still cough

{"function":"report_triage","severity":"YELLOW","headline":"Partial airway obstruction","immediate_steps":["Encourage them to keep coughing forcefully — coughing is the most effective way to clear it","Stay calm beside them, do not slap their back yet — that can worsen things","If coughing weakens or they can no longer make sounds, treat as full obstruction and call emergency services"],"do_not":["Do not give water or food","Do not perform abdominal thrusts on someone who can still cough effectively"],"watch_for":["Inability to make sound, blue lips, or collapse — RED, do back blows and abdominal thrusts and call services","Persistent throat pain after the object clears — see a doctor"]}
hand caught in machinery, mangled

{"function":"escalate_emergency","reason":"Severe crush or amputation injury","single_action":"Call emergency services NOW. Apply pressure to bleeding with a clean cloth.","while_waiting":["If part is amputated, wrap it in a clean cloth, place it in a clean plastic bag, and put the bag on ice (not directly on the part)","Keep the person warm and lying down","Maintain pressure on bleeding","Note the time of injury"]}
drowning, just pulled out of the water

{"function":"escalate_emergency","reason":"Near-drowning — risk of cardiac arrest, lung damage","single_action":"Call emergency services NOW. Check for breathing.","while_waiting":["If not breathing and you know CPR, start chest compressions and rescue breaths","If breathing, place on side (recovery position)","Remove wet clothing and warm them with dry blankets","All near-drowning cases should be evaluated at a hospital — symptoms can appear hours later"]}
frostbite on fingers, white and numb

{"function":"report_triage","severity":"YELLOW","headline":"Frostbite on fingers","immediate_steps":["Move to a warm place","Soak the fingers in warm (not hot) water — 37-39°C / 99-102°F — for 20-30 minutes","After warming, wrap loosely with clean dry cloth, fingers separated","See a doctor today"],"do_not":["Do not rub the affected area","Do not use direct heat (fire, heating pad)","Do not re-warm if there is any chance of re-freezing — that's worse than staying frozen"],"watch_for":["Black or blistered skin — emergency","Severe pain on rewarming is normal; numbness that persists is concerning"]}
heat stroke — confused, very hot, not sweating
